notes: - **The Meeting notes engine list now says truthfully what each engine does during the call.** Under each name one chip reads **Live: speakers named during the call** (Deepgram, AssemblyAI), **Live: delayed · speakers named during the call** (a model on this PC), **Live transcript · speakers after the call**, or **No live transcript**, and the **Identifies speakers** badges line up in one column. The chips come from the same facts the Live window uses, so they can't drift from what it does. AssemblyAI no longer says its speakers come only after the call. See [Models](/docs/models/).
